summary: Four actionable UI defects remain: attention pagination resets on events, conflict reload leaves stale invalid JSON saveable, accepted discard leaves the editor open, and zone errors identify the cron field. Rendered controls checked at 1440/900/390 on stable verified source/build. Isolated server/browser/database cleanup completed.

findings.location: Workflow Schedules editor, browser Back to Runs; WorkflowEditor.tsx:1091 and Schedules.tsx:548
findings.problem: Discard changes navigates to Runs but leaves the schedule editor open with the discarded draft and an enabled save action.
findings.consequence: The modal blocks the destination, and the operator can still save edits explicitly discarded.
findings.suggestedChange: Dismiss and reset schedule editor state when guarded navigation is accepted, while preserving Keep editing and pending-write protection.

findings.location: Schedule editor conflict reload; Schedules.tsx:1033 and JsonEditor.tsx:25
findings.problem: Reload marks JSON valid without resetting its raw editor buffer when the server JSON serializes unchanged. Invalid text remains visible and Save succeeds with earlier JSON.
findings.consequence: The form displays a different input from the input submitted and persisted.
findings.suggestedChange: Reset displayed JSON and validity atomically on explicit reload, using a reset identity or controlled editor reset.

findings.problem: An unrelated run event changes tick and remounts ScheduleAlerts, resetting a later attention page to offset zero.
findings.consequence: Frequent engine activity interrupts inspection of later alerts and removes the Previous control.
findings.suggestedChange: Keep component identity stable per workflow and refresh its current page without resetting offset.

findings.location: Schedule Timing, IANA time zone and Cron expression; Schedules.tsx:839 and :852
findings.problem: Invalid time-zone errors appear beneath and are associated with the valid Cron expression field. The invalid zone field has no error association.
findings.consequence: Visual and assistive-technology error recovery directs the operator to the wrong field.
findings.suggestedChange: Preserve nested validation paths and attach zone, expression, and interval errors to their corresponding Mantine controls.

gaps: Archived, removed-publication, and imported-disabled variants were inspected in source but not rendered. Unpublished prerequisite and disabled creation were exercised.
Large fire-history and schedule-list paging were inspected in source but not exercised. Attention paging was exercised.
No physical-device or screen-reader session was performed; viewport, keyboard, DOM associations, and focus were checked.
